p.i:
3,181 items marked Apply FlexShip;
141 marked Reject FlexShip

div.style: color: rgb(71, 85, 105) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Today this is reconciled by hand against
Bosta statements. 3,181 compensations over
7 months is roughly 15 per working day
being matched manually.

original cost - compensation

span.p:
A compensation NEVER edits the original
snapshot. It appends a new one, dated when
the compensation was confirmed. The item's
margin at time of sale stays intact, and the
improvement is attributable to a date.
(Requirement 6.3)
